purpose: Exploratory extension of lean_utility_trained_channel_pilot_v1: train the existing TCMN author channel gate directly on complete-source deletion effects, where same-key-count diagnostic effects were larger than mixed random groups. This design was selected after inspecting prior results and is not preregistered independent validation.
split_and_inputs: Use previously fixed seq2/3/4 development and seq9/10 sequence-separated evaluation reads. Use only automatic prompt prototypes and verified source early-FPN features as descriptors. Each of the five groups is one whole older source of 1024 keys; prompt, newest and pointers are protected. Decomposed channel features must sum to the existing unweighted foreground-background contrast within 1e-6. Descriptors and predictions are saved before joining evaluation outcomes.
target: Within each labeled-present development read, pairwise rank the groups by full-read Dice minus source-deletion Dice. A higher value means the source helped that frozen read, conditional on other keys and attention renormalization. Exactly tied targets are excluded; reads have equal weight. No labels are inputs at inference.
training: Reuse the exact fixed architecture and training settings of lean_utility_trained_channel_pilot_v1: TCMN ChannelGate with 32 channels, AdamW lr 0.01, weight decay 0.0001, 100 full-batch steps, seed 20261114, detached per-read standard deviation plus 1e-6, logistic pairwise loss. No checkpoint selection using evaluation outcomes. Save two deterministic runs and require predictions to be reproducible from the research-only checkpoint.
evaluation: Compare within-read concordance and equal-key mask selection with unweighted FPN, previously occupancy-trained CBAM, RGB, shuffled and age controls. One source per arm and same read, source membership and token count are matched. Current evaluation sequences were previously examined and patient independence is unknown. Historical pre-read Lean usage scores and a distributed policy are not captured; prior priority studies provide separate controls. Report individual sequences and empty-read false alarms. Do not promote unless evidence warrants it; no redetection, new confidence gate or untrained inference weights.
